entities.summary: Paula Vesala (b. 1981-12-10, Kärsämäki) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kärsämäki and Finland. Known in the fields of finland, poets & playwrights, europe.
